Why HerFit

Bani hi khawateen ke liye hai

Quetta ki aksar khawateen gym is liye nahi jati ke wahan sahulat nahi — balke is liye ke wahan sukoon nahi milta. HerFit mein har cheez isi ek baat ke gird bani hai.

🔒

Parday ka pura ehtimam

Workout floor par sirf khawateen. Koi male staff, koi male member ladies hours mein andar nahi aata. Aap hijab mein aayein ya baghair — jese comfortable hain, wese train karein.

🎯

Personal plan, sirf aap ke liye

Join karne par free body assessment: weight, BMI aur goal ke hisaab se aap ka apna workout + diet plan banta hai. Har mahine progress check hota hai.

🤝

Beginners ke liye asan shuruaat

Pehli dafa gym aana mushkil lagta hai — yahan nahi. Pehle hafte trainer har machine aur exercise hath pakar kar sikhati hai. Koi embarrassment nahi, sirf support.

💰

Saaf fees, koi chhupa charge nahi

Jo fees neeche likhi hai, wahi hai. Koi hidden charges nahi, koi lamba contract nahi. Freeze option bhi hai — travel ya bemari par membership ruk jati hai, zaya nahi hoti.

Aksar pooche jane wale sawal

Ji bilkul. Ladies hours mein workout floor par sirf khawateen members aur female trainers hoti hain. Male staff ka ladies area mein dakhal mukammal band hai.
Ek poori class ya floor session bilkul free. Trainer aap ko gym dikhayegi, machines samjhayegi aur goal ke hisaab se mashwara degi. Pasand aye to join karein — koi zabardasti nahi.
Bilkul. Hamari aksar members pehli dafa hi yahan aati hain. Pehla hafta beginner plan chalta hai aur trainer har step par sath hoti hai.
Ji, bohat si members sports hijab mein train karti hain. Floor sirf khawateen ke liye hai, is liye aap jese comfortable hain wese a sakti hain.
Han — safar, bemari ya kisi majboori par membership mahine mein ek dafa freeze ho jati hai, din zaya nahi hote. Sirf WhatsApp par pehle se bata dein.
WhatsApp par message karein ya neeche wala chat button dabayein — chatbot foran fees, timings aur location bata dega, aur trial booking bhi wahi se ho jayegi.
